spans: FOX INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY: Consistent with Paragraph 11(b) of the Agreement all music developed and used in connection with the "IN HER SHOES" Wireless Product shall be owned exclusively by Fox.

Licensee shall have the non-exclusive right and license to develop and distribute ICE AGE 2 Wireless Products during the Term of the Agreement for all Wireless Products set forth in this Paragraph 2(c) except the Game, for which Licensee shall have the exclusive right and license to develop and distribute until December 31, 2006.

Paragraph 1(a) of the Agreement is amended to provide that Fox grants Licensee a worldwide, exclusive (except as otherwise may be provided in the Agreement), non-transferable right and license to distribute video clips for the property "KINGDOM OF HEAVEN" ("KOH Video Clips").

Reference is hereby made to that certain fully executed Wireless Content License Agreement Number 12965 dated as of December 16, 2004 ("Agreement"), between TWENTIETH CENTURY FOX LICENSING & MERCHANDISING, division of Fox Entertainment Group, Inc. ("Fox"), as Administrator for Twentieth Century Fox Film Corporation ("Trademark Licensor") and Glu Mobile, Inc. f/k/a Sorrent, Inc. ("Licensee").

FOX ASSIGNMENT OF AGREEMENT: Pursuant to Twentieth Century Fox Licensing and Merchandising's assignment of rights and obligations through an assignment dated as of October 1, 2005 by and between Twentieth Century Fox Licensing and Merchandising and Fox Mobile Entertainment Inc., Fox Mobile Entertainment, Inc. is hereby substituted for Twentieth Century Fox Licensing and Merchandising as "Fox" under the Agreement.
Glu Mobile, Inc. f/k/a Sorrent, Inc. Fox Mobile Entertainment, Inc. ("Fox") ("Licensee")
Parties.answer: Fox Mobile Entertainment, Inc. ("Fox"); Glu Mobile, Inc. f/k/a Sorrent, Inc. ("Licensee")

notes: This document is Amendment No. 1 (dated 11/11/2005) to an underlying Wireless Content License Agreement Number 12965 dated 12/16/2004, which is referenced but not reproduced in this file; Document Name, Agreement Date, and all other calls are based on this Amendment's own text only, per the brief. Parties reflects the current signatories after the Section 1(a) substitution (Fox Mobile Entertainment, Inc. stepping into "Fox" in place of Twentieth Century Fox Licensing & Merchandising) and the Section 1(b) Licensee name change (Sorrent, Inc. to Glu Mobile, Inc.); the original "Trademark Licensor" (Twentieth Century Fox Film Corporation) is named in the recital but not a signatory to this Amendment. Expiration Date, Governing Law, Anti-Assignment, Audit Rights, Cap on Liability, Insurance and Non-Compete are absent because this Amendment's text contains no clauses responsive to them (it only references an undefined "Term of the Agreement" and various property-specific license-expiry dates, not an overall initial-term expiration).
